notes.text: The exact third section links the seven Sabbath blessings to seven mentions of the divine name in Psalm 92. This confirms the chapter and mishnah 3; the first cited unit remains open. The direct witness gives Yudan Antodrayya in the lentil custom and eulogy material. The chapter called Amar Rabbi Akiva is Shabbat 9. Its direct witness gives the almost identical Antadrayya form for the explanation of snow and wool. The verified Horayot passage has Yehudah Antodrayya on anointing priestly kings, with a parallel in Shekalim. At the end of Jerusalem Shekalim he puts the two consecration rulings to R. Yosah. The parallel late-sugya reference to R. Yosi bar Bun remains a separate unresolved witness question.
